ios.desc:
Finally, a news app with absolutely no ads or distractions.


Free Features:

News v2 Live News: Explore the latest headlines across over 24 categories and effortlessly save your favorite topics.

News v2 Speed Reader: Test your reading speed and boost your efficiency with AI-crafted news reports updated every morning and evening. (Bonus: Paste any text to speed-read any article.)


Premium Features ($2.99/month):

News v2 Daily Audio Briefings: Listen to the latest news with real-time transcripts. Get top headlines in Business, Sports, Technology, Health, and Science every morning and evening.

News v2 Live News with AI Summaries: Instantly generate concise, bulleted AI summaries of the latest stories.


News categories: Top, Business, Technology, World, Sports, Health, Science, Politics, National, Finance, Football, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, Golf, Movies, Music, AI, Crypto, Cyber Security, Travel, Medicine, Environment, Space, Paleontology, and FDA.


Our mission is simple: deliver news without ads or distractions.


For more information and news: https://newsv2.com/


Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://newsv2.com/privacy-ios
Support: https://newsv2.com/support

quotes.text:
Been building out my ad free news platform and built a simple, clean, and ad free ios app for users to get the latest headlines without any distractions.

Started building this a couple months ago because i got tired of cluttered news websites with ads and was getting too distracted when trying to get news from social media.

App is free to download from iOS store and would appreciate feedback.

Has news feed of latest headlines across 24+ categories and a news speed reader that helps users speed read the new through AI generated analysis of the latest news.

Feel free to try and send feedback or comments to news@newsv2.com
